text:
Morgan Lee: heads-up — found a reproducible failure in TS SDK when json mode + auth retry enabled during the sampleapp onboarding flow.
Alex Chen: how bad? crash or just validator errors?
Morgan Lee: validator crash. Repro steps: run sampleapp with REAUTH=1 and ts-sdk 0.12.7-rc2. Intermittently the fncall response becomes a quoted string containing an already-stringified JSON array, e.g. "["{\"name\":\"task1\",\"tasks\":[] }"]" and then our schema validator chokes.
Tasha Nguyen: that's nasty. Any idea why only TS and not Python?
Sahil Rao: my hunch is our JS retry wrapper calls JSON.stringify on the payload on retry and the core response parser expects raw JSON. Python's client path doesn't double-stringify.
Alex Chen: CI evidence?
ci-bot: test/devex/sampleapp-jsonmode — 3 failures in the last 24h (flaky).
Morgan Lee: pasted sanitized logs in the repo: https://stash.redwood/sampleapp-jsonmode-repro with minimal repro and README.
Sahil Rao: can you drop the exact SDK lockfile/version? we pushed a retry wrapper change in 0.12.7-rc2.
Morgan Lee: yes ts-sdk@0.12.7-rc2. py-sdk@0.12.6.
Tasha Nguyen: short-term mitigation: set ENV AUTH_RETRY=false for onboarding, or add a response hook to attempt JSON.parse if validator fails. We'll update onboarding docs.
Alex Chen: assign to eng-tooling. @Sahil can you take a look and add unit tests that mock 401 -> success plus stringified payload?
Sahil Rao: picking this up. I'll add a unit that simulates an auth refresh mid-flight and ensure the retry path doesn't re-serialize already-stringified bodies.
Morgan Lee: filed issue DEVEX-1429 with logs and repro link.
Tasha Nguyen: I'll draft a docs patch to /docs/onboarding/quickstart mentioning the workaround.
Sahil Rao: quick fix likely small: check if response is string and try parse before validator, but better to prevent double-encode at source.
Alex Chen: please post PR numbers. We'll include in next patch release if safe.
Morgan Lee: thanks — ping when PR lands. :thumbsup:
